slurm: Two existing serial four-hour training allocations followed by three serial four-hour evaluation allocations; depend on all active recorded training jobs and validate the training completion marker before evaluation.
recovery: Reuse validated completed training and predictions. Resume compatible partial evaluation files by question ID. Preserve malformed/changed attempts; at most three attempts per result.
completion: Require twelve real full trained B checkpoints and twenty-four complete, unique 500-question development prediction files with matching checkpoint, manifest, question and parser hashes.
limitations: Original 25-exclusion/572-quarantine audit remains unresolved in reviewed copies.
Inherited parent/development exposure remains disclosed; screening is not a certification of contamination absence.
Legacy B remains a separate condition. Use screened B with screened C0/C1 for a pool-matched comparison.
C1 remains an exploratory frozen refinement; its existing diagnostic gate is unchanged.
Queue delays, time limits, node failures and scientific-input drift can prevent overnight completion.
Local CPU checks do not constitute a real Sol GPU execution or evaluation receipt.
